sections.label: Four seats rule Wealth in your chart. One sits in your Early Chapter, one in your Home Chapter and two in your Late Chapter.
sections.text: Your money comes through the people close to you.

You find money through other people, in a tip from a friend or a side venture with someone close. Because your openings arrive through people you trust, you say yes before you read the terms, and you earn in bursts more than in a steady line. The money you make fastest is the money you hold on to least.

What you make turns into money more easily for you than for most, and the work that feels like play is the work that pays you best. Because making and earning share a gate, you barely see a line between your craft and your income.

sections.text: Money at home was counted and spent with care, and you learned what things cost before most children do. By your teens you were already saving what your friends spent.

sections.text: Fed well as a child, you now feed everyone else.

You hold your family together through comfort, the visit kept and the favour done and the table set. Because care reached you first as warmth, you give it back the same way, and you feel useless in a family crisis that kindness cannot touch. What you want from your family is ease, and you work hard to make it.

sections.text: Your work pays for what only you know.

Because you trust knowledge you have dug out yourself, you are drawn to a narrow field the mainstream ignores, and you would rather be paid for strange work than praised for ordinary work. You earn more from the niche you choose than any ladder would pay you.

You also rise by making more rather than by climbing, as each piece of work you finish brings the next one to your door. Because making and earning share a gate, you barely see a line between your craft and your income.

Because comfort is how you recover, you reach for it under stress, and you turn the extra helping or the lost weekend into a habit before you notice. Your body asks you for rhythm more than for effort.

sections.text: Rivalry over shared work drains your energy, and a joint effort takes more from you than it pays. You get through on work that is plainly yours, done where the people who matter can see it.

sections.label: An Alchemist decade · 2052 to 2061
sections.text: Your work wanders between private study and side projects, and steady output is hard to keep up. Each time a side path stalls, you return to the one method people pay you for.

sections.label: 2026 · a Virtuoso year
sections.text: Sure of your skill and short with the rules, you say out loud this year what colleagues only grumble about.

sections.label: 2027 · an Artisan year
sections.text: You get paid more readily this year for what you enjoy making, because your work loosens and pleases people.

sections.label: 2028 · a Steward year
sections.text: Your pay tracks your effort this year, earned through the hours you put in and the details you get right.

sections.label: 2030 · a Magistrate year
sections.text: Your work gains a title, a rule book or a formal promise this year, leaving you with more trust at the end of it than at the start.

sections.label: 2031 · a General year
sections.text: You hold up better than anyone expects this year, when a demanding task or a rival with standing tests your work.

sections.label: Three seats rule Family in your chart. One sits in your Early Chapter and two in your Late Chapter.
sections.text: You love your family in an unusual way.

You show love to your family through ideas and help with problems more than through surface warmth. Because the care you got early was quiet and odd, you trust a relative who understands you over one who fusses, and you feel lonely at noisy gatherings. You come home as the quiet one, a part your relatives have long stopped trying to change.

sections.label: The Alchemist inside the Year Gate · Early Chapter · birth to 15 · lived
sections.text: Instead of the usual fuss you got books, questions and long silences from an adult in your first home who lived in their own head. What you took from it was the habit of answering your own odd questions before you thought to ask anyone else.

sections.label: The Artisan at the Hour Gate · Late Chapter · from 48 · 2044 · in plain view · coming
sections.text: From your late forties you become the place the people after you come to rest, the slow meal and the spare bed and the evening nobody rushes. You enjoy them more as they grow easy around you, unhurried and well fed.

sections.label: The Horizon inside the Hour Gate · Late Chapter · from 48 · 2044 · coming
sections.text: From your late forties the people after you open new places to you, a spare bed in a far city and a reason to stay a month. Your visits become the link between them, and those gatherings matter more to you than anything you could buy them.

sections.label: An Artisan decade · 2012 to 2021
sections.text: Home was warm, full of meals and unhurried evenings with the people you lived with. You were the comfort everyone at home gathered around.

sections.label: A Twin decade · 2032 to 2041
sections.text: Pride runs through your family, each person insisting on their own way and quarrelling over it. You come through by doing your part well and leaving others to theirs.

sections.label: A Sage decade · 2062 to 2071
sections.text: Family care comes with conditions, and help arrives with a say in your choices. You hold steady by keeping a way of your own without a quarrel, and the bond survives the distance you need.

sections.label: 2027 · an Artisan year
sections.text: This year you cook, host and make the place feel lived in, with home gathering around food and easy company.

sections.label: 2028 · a Steward year
sections.text: You keep the household accounts this year and see to family property, holding the home in careful order.

sections.label: 2029 · a Horizon year
sections.text: Your family life widens this year to relatives far away or newly met, drawing your time and money to people beyond your own door.

sections.label: 2030 · a Magistrate year
sections.text: You carry family duties in full view of your relatives this year, from the paperwork and signatures to speaking for the household.

sections.label: Three seats rule Social in your chart. One sits in your Early Chapter, one in your Rising Chapter and one in your Home Chapter.
sections.text: You know someone for every need.

You collect contacts the way other people collect friends, and you love introducing people who will get on. Because your network brings you work and money, the useful friendships and the warm ones get mixed together. You give a real friend the same quick hour you give a contact, and the difference is the last thing you notice.

sections.label: The Virtuoso at the Year Gate · Early Chapter · birth to 15 · in plain view · lived
sections.text: When you were a child, your remarks were the ones other people repeated, at home and in class. By your teens you had a few friends who loved your wit and one or two adults who had given up on correcting you.

sections.label: The Horizon at the Month Gate · Rising Chapter · 16 to 34 · in plain view · now
sections.text: Many of your friendships since your late teens began far from home, over a deal or a trip or a shared plan. You have kept a friend in each of the worlds you passed through, and a few of them have become close for life.

sections.label: The Horizon inside the Day Gate · Home Chapter · from 35 · 2031 · coming
sections.text: Your circle widens from your mid-thirties through a partner's world, through their friends and their family and their work. In your forties you know more people through a partner's side than through your own.

sections.label: A Virtuoso decade · 2022 to 2031 · now
sections.text: You become more outspoken, and the people who enjoy a sharp voice seek you out. You gather an audience of your own and lose patience with company that asks you to be quieter.

sections.label: A Twin decade · 2032 to 2041
sections.text: Company that truly matches you is scarce, and crowded groups wear you out quickly. You get through on your own strength, and prize a quiet evening over a full calendar.

sections.label: A Rival decade · 2042 to 2051
sections.text: Comparison creeps into your friendships, and you notice who earns more and who wins more. You win friends back by giving a share freely, and a fair split comes to matter more to you than the prize.

sections.label: 2026 · a Virtuoso year
sections.text: Your conversations with friends grow sharper and wittier this year, until you are the one your circle quotes the next day.

sections.label: 2029 · a Horizon year
sections.text: You move easily this year between groups that never meet each other, carried there by chance meetings and introductions.

sections.label: 2030 · a Magistrate year
sections.text: You take on roles among friends this year, a committee seat or a host's duty, and become known for showing up when you said you would.

sections.label: Three seats rule Mind in your chart. Two sit in your Early Chapter and one in your Rising Chapter.
sections.text: You learn steadily, and the learning holds.

Week by week you add to what you know, studying in a steady and patient way. Because understanding a thing fully is what makes you feel secure, you read the extra chapter and take the extra course, and you speak on a subject only once you are sure of it. You know far more than you claim to.

sections.label: The Virtuoso at the Year Gate · Early Chapter · birth to 15 · in plain view · lived
sections.text: You finished the work early at school and went looking for something harder, or for trouble when nothing harder came. By your teens you were teaching yourself subjects well beyond your class and hiding how bored you were.

sections.label: The Alchemist inside the Year Gate · Early Chapter · birth to 15 · lived
sections.text: Whatever you were given to read when you were small, you read past it into subjects nobody around you shared. By your teens you knew more about a few odd things than most adults did, mentioning it only to the one or two people who asked.

sections.label: The Sage inside the Month Gate · Rising Chapter · 16 to 34 · now
sections.text: Learning has carried you since your late teens, through courses and qualifications and the teachers who took an interest. You have stayed a student in some form ever since, and it has kept you steadier than most people around you.
Your later gates hold no Mind seat, so your decades set its course from here.

sections.label: A Virtuoso decade · 2022 to 2031 · now
sections.text: You turn your thinking outward, and you say in public what you used to keep to yourself. You are quicker and bolder with ideas than at any time before.

sections.label: An Alchemist decade · 2052 to 2061
sections.text: Your mind turns inward, and long stretches of solitary thought leave work half done. You finish more once a single person understands your odd way of thinking and waits to see the result.

sections.label: A Sage decade · 2062 to 2071
sections.text: Caution settles over your thinking, and you read about things far more than you try them. You trust your own ideas again once teaching puts them to work in someone else.

sections.label: 2026 · a Virtuoso year

sections.label: Two seats rule Growth in your chart. One sits in your Early Chapter and one in your Rising Chapter.
sections.text: Your growth waits on a readiness you already have.

Each step you take comes after the training is done and the support is in place. Because shelter feels like the right place to prepare, you stay in safe roles past the point they teach you anything, and you wait for one more sign that you are ready. You are readier than you feel, and have been for a long time.

sections.label: The Alchemist inside the Year Gate · Early Chapter · birth to 15 · lived
sections.text: The people who taught you most as a child stood outside the usual line, the neighbour or relative with odd interests who took you seriously. You grew in directions your family could not follow, and stopped expecting them to before you were fifteen.

sections.label: The Sage inside the Month Gate · Rising Chapter · 16 to 34 · now
sections.text: From your late teens you have grown in sheltered steps, under teachers and seniors who prepared you well. You have done better than you feared each time you moved, standing on the base they gave you.
Your later gates hold no Growth seat, so your decades set its course from here.

sections.label: A Twin decade · 2032 to 2041
sections.text: Comparison with peers drives you hard, and the standard you hold yourself to leaves you little slack. You will keep growing once the only measure you use is your own last best.

sections.label: An Alchemist decade · 2052 to 2061
sections.text: Solitary searching slows you, with many interests started and few carried through. Your progress stays hidden until one obscure project is finished, and on that day you will see how far you have come.

sections.label: 2031 · a General year
sections.text: You grow fastest this year where something forces you to, a deadline or a rival or a role with real stakes.

sections.label: One seat rules Love in your chart. It sits in your Home Chapter.
sections.text: You fall for people who widen your life.

In love you fall for the one with plans and friends and somewhere to be. Because range is what draws you, you lose interest within months in a partner who only offers closeness. What you want is someone who brings the world home, and anyone who shuts it out leaves you restless.

sections.label: The Horizon inside the Day Gate · Home Chapter · from 35 · 2031 · coming
sections.text: From your mid-thirties love and money start to move together. You choose a partner in these years who brings an opening into your life, and the bond holds for as long as the two of you keep heading somewhere new.
Love has no decade of its own. It is read from your Day Gate alone.

Each decade moves your health more than any single habit of yours. You feel well for some stretches of years and worn for others, with each turn arriving as one decade gives way to the next.

sections.label: An Artisan decade · 2012 to 2021
sections.text: Your appetite and sleep were good, and ordinary pleasures kept you well. Eating well and moving without strain, you felt at home in your own body.

sections.label: A Sage decade · 2062 to 2071
sections.text: Too much rest dulls you, and sheltered days leave you flat. Your energy returns whenever someone needs looking after, because it gets you up early and moving.

sections.label: 2027 · an Artisan year
sections.text: Your body follows the pace you set this year, with meals, sleep and easy pleasures filling more of your days.

sections.label: 2031 · a General year
sections.text: Pressure settles into your body this year as tension you carry without noticing, and you feel it first in your sleep.

sections.label: A Sage structure · 正印格
sections.text: Your chart rests on shelter and learning, on teachers who back you and places that look after their own. You do your best work where study is valued and someone senior vouches for you. You repay that care with years of loyalty.
Nothing hidden in your strongest seat shows on your stems. The Sage who holds it is the organising force of your life, and you answer to it first.

sections.label: Formed.
sections.text: Support holds steady around you, from teachers, credentials and people who speak up for you. You can lean on what you have learned, and on the people who taught you, whenever a setback comes.
Water alone carries more than half of your chart, and you live mostly through what you think.

sections.label: no Twin · it arrives with your decade 2032 to 2041
sections.text: Going it alone is never your first move. With a team or a close friend beside you, you find your footing faster and hold it longer.

sections.label: no Steward · your season asks for it too · your Steward decade 2002 to 2011 is lived
sections.text: You do the books when you must and not a day sooner. You handle money in bursts and forget it for months, leaning on a partner or a spreadsheet to keep track.

sections.label: no Magistrate · no decade of yours brings it
sections.text: You look to others to learn what the rules are. You borrow structure from a boss or a contract, and you work best once someone else has fixed the terms.

sections.text: Early winter brings cold water up around your roots, more than a vine can take in, and growth stops. The month turns to Fire first to warm you and then to Earth as solid ground to hold back the water and give you footing. You stay above the flood when warmth and firm ground reach you together.

sections.text: You carry the Virtuoso openly on a stem, and its element cuts a channel for the force your season keeps pent up in you.

sections.label: the Artisan
sections.text: You seem easygoing and warm, the friend who cooks for everyone and makes hard work look light.

You save what sits inside for the few people who know you best.

sections.text: You build your own home close to the habits of the one you grew up in, and you return to them more than you expected.

You move from one chapter of your life to the next without a sharp break, because no clash, punishment or harm sits between your gates.

sections.text: You build a career by spotting openings first.

You are drawn to work where timing matters, buying and selling or finding things before others notice them. Because you read change early, a job where nothing moves bores you, and you leave it sooner than you planned. In any role you end up as the person who sees what is coming next.
Underneath, you do your calmest work closest to pressure, because the deadlines that grind other people turn into steady output in your hands.

sections.label: The General at the Year Gate · Early Chapter · birth to 15 · in plain view · lived
sections.text: Pressure beyond your age reached you in your first years, a job at home or a team to lead or younger children to mind. The weight felt heavy at the time, but you came out of it tougher than most of your friends.

sections.label: The General at the Month Gate · Rising Chapter · 16 to 34 · in plain view · lived
sections.text: Through your Rising Chapter your reputation at work grew out of hard moments, the emergency handled or the project rescued. Your promotions came out of the worst weeks, each one earned by the nerve you showed when a project was close to failing.

sections.label: The Horizon inside the Month Gate · Rising Chapter · 16 to 34 · lived
sections.text: In your twenties and early thirties your best jobs were the ones where you could spot a trend early, in trading or sales or finding the right people. With every move you widened your range of contacts, until chances reached you before anyone announced them.

sections.label: The Artisan at the Hour Gate · Late Chapter · 48 on · in plain view · now
sections.text: Since your late forties your work has turned toward making, hosting and finishing the projects you had put off for years. You have made some of your best things in this stretch, better received than anything from your busier decades.

sections.label: A Steward decade · 1998 to 2007
sections.text: Safety kept you in one place too long, and your workload grew faster than your pay. You carried the extra load reliably and earned a trust that later work paid for.

sections.label: An Artisan decade · 2008 to 2017
sections.text: Comfort dulled your drive, and easy work held you longer than it served you. Well liked and under-stretched, you kept going on a skill you practised for pleasure.

sections.label: A Virtuoso decade · 2018 to 2027 · now
sections.text: Authority pushes back on you, and a frank remark costs more than it used to. You do better outside a strict chain of command, where work in your own voice carries you through.

sections.label: A Rival decade · 2038 to 2047
sections.text: Joint efforts carry your work, and you do best inside a group with something to win. You compete hard, share credit fairly and keep the backing of the people beside you.

sections.text: Your family spreads wide and gathers in bursts.

You love it best when your whole family gathers for a few full days, and you plan those days months early. Because distance has never felt like loss to you, long gaps between visits pass without worry. You travel far for a short visit, and the people you miss get many arrivals and few long stays.

sections.label: The Sage inside the Year Gate · Early Chapter · birth to 15 · lived
sections.text: An older relative looked after you closely when you were small, and you came to rely on their calm. You grew up expecting the world to treat you with the same care, and mostly it did.

sections.label: The Artisan at the Hour Gate · Late Chapter · 48 on · in plain view · now
sections.text: You have become the relative who hosts since your late forties, the one whose table the people after you head for first. You see your own habits of ease in how they now treat their guests, down to the second helping.

sections.label: The Horizon inside the Hour Gate · Late Chapter · 48 on · now
sections.text: Your family has spread to new places since your late forties, the people after you settling far from you and from each other. You have travelled more for them than for any holiday, and their streets have grown nearly as familiar to you as your own.

sections.label: A Horizon decade · 1988 to 1997
sections.text: Plans and people far from home pulled you away, and your family saw less of you than they wanted. You made up for it in bursts of generosity, and relatives forgave more readily than you feared.

sections.label: A Steward decade · 1998 to 2007
sections.text: Careful keeping outweighed pleasure at home, and you noticed every purchase anyone made. You kept the household secure if a little tense, carried by the relatives who thanked you plainly.

sections.label: An Artisan decade · 2008 to 2017
sections.text: You gave your family more comfort than they asked for, and some of them came to expect it. Your own ease came back once others began to cook for you in turn.

sections.label: A Twin decade · 2028 to 2037
sections.text: Your household runs on shared effort, with each person carrying a fair part of the load. You pull your weight before anyone asks and meet every relative as one equal meets another.

sections.label: 2027 · an Artisan year
sections.text: This year you cook, host and make the place feel lived in, with home gathering around food and easy company.

sections.text: Your friendships are tested before they are trusted.

You size up new people by how they act when something goes wrong, and you warm to anyone who keeps their nerve. Because you trust only what has been tested, light talk at a party feels like a waste of your evening. Your friendships are few and serious, and loyalty under strain is the one test you set.

sections.label: The General at the Year Gate · Early Chapter · birth to 15 · in plain view · lived
sections.text: As a child you were the one others looked to in a fight or a dare, and you did not give way easily. Your friends by your teens were either as tough as you or kept at a distance, and you learned diplomacy slowly.

sections.label: The General at the Month Gate · Rising Chapter · 16 to 34 · in plain view · lived
sections.text: In your Rising Chapter your closest friends were the people you worked hardest beside, in a tough job or a demanding team. You came out of each hard stretch with an ally who answered your call at any hour.

sections.label: The Twin inside the Day Gate · Home Chapter · 35 to 47 · lived
sections.text: In your late thirties and forties your closest friendships were between equals, people who never needed you to rescue them. You kept every friendship level, with nothing owed in either direction.

sections.label: A Horizon decade · 1988 to 1997
sections.text: Acquaintances crowded your life, and you knew people in many places without letting many of them close. You kept your footing by moving on, with every new place a fresh start.

sections.label: A Virtuoso decade · 2018 to 2027 · now
sections.text: Bluntness strains your friendships, and some people hear an attack where you meant wit. You will steady yourself by giving that edge a stage, a talk or a page where sharpness is the point.

sections.label: A Twin decade · 2028 to 2037
sections.text: Friendship settles into a circle of equals, people with lives and strength of their own. You trust that small, solid circle more than any crowd.

sections.label: A Rival decade · 2038 to 2047

sections.text: Your money comes in strong seasons and quiet ones.

sections.label: The Horizon inside the Month Gate · Rising Chapter · 16 to 34 · lived
sections.text: What you earned from sixteen to your mid-thirties followed your instinct, with good runs and lean months in turn. You came out of those years knowing how your own streaks ran, a lesson paid for with the gains of good years spent chasing better ones.

sections.label: The Horizon inside the Hour Gate · Late Chapter · 48 on · now
sections.text: Since your late forties your money has come in sideways, through late ventures and deals struck while travelling. You have spent much of it as fast as it arrived, and that motion has kept new chances reaching you.

sections.label: A Horizon decade · 1988 to 1997
sections.text: Easy money came and went, and each windfall left as fast as it arrived. You chased too many openings at once and held on through the one steady source you kept.

sections.label: A Steward decade · 1998 to 2007
sections.text: Expenses felt heavy, and you counted money long after there was enough. You came through on the security careful habit built, though your pleasure shrank as your savings grew.

sections.label: A Rival decade · 2038 to 2047
sections.text: Shared money works for you, because the contest with others keeps you sharp. You do better with people at your side than alone and keep a fair cut of what you win together.

sections.label: One seat rules Health in your chart. It sits in your Early Chapter.
sections.text: Your body recovers best when someone looks after you.

You get your energy back quickly after tiring weeks and bad nights, and faster still when someone close is fussing over you. Because care was what restored you from the start, you let yourself rest properly only when another person insists. Your body does well on trust, rest and good company.
You find your protection in comfort, because good food and work with your hands turn pressure into something you can use.

sections.label: The Sage inside the Year Gate · Early Chapter · birth to 15 · lived
sections.text: Whenever you were run down as a child, an older relative was there with an early night and a watchful eye. Growing up, you learned that being looked after was part of getting your strength back, and letting others do it came easily.

sections.label: Late Chapter · 48 to now · no Health seat.
sections.text: From your late forties, you take your energy from the decade you are in, and the people after you give your days their shape.

sections.label: 2027 · an Artisan year

sections.label: The Twin inside the Day Gate · Home Chapter · 35 to 47 · lived
sections.text: In your late thirties and forties your closest bonds were with people who needed no rescuing, and the partners who leaned on you faded within a season. From those years you built a way of loving side by side, with neither of you walking behind.
Love has no decade of its own. The pattern your Day Gate set is the one your love life keeps.

sections.label: One seat rules Growth in your chart. It sits in your Early Chapter.
sections.text: Your growth starts from a safe base.

Underneath, you answer the years that weigh on you with study and the people who steady you, ending every heavy stretch more sure of who you are. In you the two sit at one gate, and you rarely meet a pressure without learning from it.

sections.label: The Sage inside the Year Gate · Early Chapter · birth to 15 · lived
sections.text: As a child you tried new things when someone you trusted stood close by, and you held back when nobody did. By your teens you were slower than your friends to try things away from home, because home felt so safe.

sections.label: Late Chapter · 48 to now · no Growth seat.
sections.text: From your late forties, you grow by settling into who you are and by teaching what you know to the people after you, as each decade turns.

sections.label: A Twin decade · 2028 to 2037

sections.label: The Artisan inside the Day Gate · Home Chapter · from 35 · 2037 · coming
sections.text: From your mid-thirties your health settles around the table you share with a partner, around food you make and evenings with nothing planned. You stay well in the fullest of these years because you take the time to enjoy them.
Your Hour Gate is closed, and your Late Chapter opens once you add your birth hour.

sections.label: A General decade · 2033 to 2042
sections.text: You carry more pressure, and for once it suits your body. You will be fitter and sharper in demanding years than in easy ones, as long as you keep sleeping.

sections.label: A Sage decade · 2043 to 2052
sections.text: Support and good rest restore you, and strain lifts quickly. You sleep soundly, with an energy that holds because you let yourself be looked after.

sections.label: 2029 · a General year
sections.text: Pressure settles into your body this year as tension you carry without noticing, and you feel it first in your sleep.

sections.label: 2030 · a Sage year
sections.text: This year you accept more looking after than you normally allow, leaning on shelter, quiet evenings and someone else's care.

sections.label: One seat rules Love in your chart. It sits in your Home Chapter.
sections.text: You show love by making life easy.

You love by doing, the meal made and the evening kept free and the worry taken off someone's hands. Since giving comfort is how you feel close, you feel most loved by a partner who receives it gladly and gives some back. You give without keeping count and are the last of your friends to notice a partner who only takes.

sections.label: The Artisan inside the Day Gate · Home Chapter · from 35 · 2037 · coming
sections.text: Past your mid-thirties love settles into an easy rhythm with a partner who makes ordinary days pleasant. Your gift for ease comes back to you in these years, as a meal cooked for you or an evening planned around your rest.
Love has no decade of its own. It is read from your Day Gate alone.

sections.label: No seat rules Mind in your chart, and your decades set its course.
sections.text: Your thinking changes character with each decade.
Your thinking takes its colour from each decade, studious in one and restless or practical in another. You notice the change in what you read before you notice it in yourself.
Your Hour Gate can hold a Mind seat, and your Late Chapter opens once you add your birth hour.

sections.label: A Sage decade · 2043 to 2052
sections.text: Learning comes easily, through books, good guides or a course taken at your own pace. Your thinking grows calmer and deeper, until you understand things you once rushed past.

sections.label: An Alchemist decade · 2053 to 2062
sections.text: Your intuition grows keen, and unusual ideas start to find a use. You become the person people bring a puzzle to, for the angle nobody else saw.

sections.label: 2030 · a Sage year
sections.text: You learn most this year when someone else sets the syllabus, with books, courses and a patient teacher filling your evenings.

sections.label: 2031 · an Alchemist year
sections.text: You study alone this year, pulled toward odd, specialist subjects nobody nearby would think to ask about.

sections.label: No seat rules Growth in your chart, and your decades set its course.
sections.text: Your growth keeps the pace of each decade.
Your growth moves at the speed of the decade you are in. You change fast in some decades and stand still in others, and only once one ends do you see which kind it was.
Your Hour Gate can hold a Growth seat, and your Late Chapter opens once you add your birth hour.

sections.label: A General decade · 2033 to 2042
sections.text: You grow fastest through pressure, a hard role or a challenge you choose on purpose. You will come out stronger in the places that used to hold you back.

sections.label: An Alchemist decade · 2053 to 2062
sections.text: Private study pays, and the things you taught yourself start to count. Your growth runs in directions nobody planned for you, toward work only you could do.

sections.label: A Twin decade · 2073 to 2082
sections.text: Comparison with peers drives you hard, and the standard you hold yourself to leaves you little slack. You will keep growing once the only measure you use is your own last best.

sections.label: 2029 · a General year
sections.text: You grow fastest this year where something forces you to, a deadline or a rival or a role with real stakes.

sections.label: 2031 · an Alchemist year
sections.text: Out of public view, you grow more yourself this year through solitary study and interests nobody assigned you.

sections.label: A Steward structure · 正财格
sections.text: Your chart is built around money kept and value earned. You do best when the work in front of you has a clear return, and you trust a slow sure gain over a fast one.
Nothing hidden in your strongest seat shows on your stems. The Steward who holds it is the organising force of your life, and you answer to it first.

sections.label: Formed.
sections.text: A pull on what you earn sits in your chart beside the lock that already holds it shut. What you have built stays put, whoever comes asking for it.
Fire and Wood carry two thirds of your chart, and you live mostly through what you earn and what you make.

sections.label: not in your three known pillars · your Hour Gate could hold it · it arrives with your decade 2073 to 2082
sections.text: The Twin does not show in your Year, Month or Day Gate, and the Hour Gate your birth time would open could still hold it. For now you think problems through with someone at your side before you carry them alone.

sections.label: not in your three known pillars · your Hour Gate could hold it · no decade of yours brings it
sections.text: The Virtuoso is absent from the gates your birth date fills, and the Hour Gate stays dark until your birth time is set. Until then you take a plan as given and save your objections for after the decision.

sections.label: not in your three known pillars · your Hour Gate could hold it · your season asks for it too · it arrives with your decade 2053 to 2062
sections.text: The Alchemist is not among the stems and branches your birth date gives, and whether the Hour Gate holds it waits on your birth time. In the meantime you take what you are taught at face value and act on it before any doubt arrives.

sections.label: 四月癸
sections.text: The air heats around you in early summer, and a rain like you can dry out before it lands. Fine Metal is what the season wants first, a cool source that keeps you replenished, with heavier Metal as the second choice. You stay fresh through the hottest days with that source close by.

sections.label: support · 庚, the Sage · hidden deep
sections.text: Deep inside one branch, you hold a little of the Sage, a faint source that still feeds your element when the season starves it.

sections.label: the Rival
sections.text: To most people you look bold and openhanded, quick to share what you have and quicker to race for more.

sections.label: the Artisan
sections.text: You seem easygoing and warm, the friend who cooks for everyone and makes hard work look light.

sections.label: the Horizon
sections.text: You keep a second plan that nobody has heard about and want more open roads than you admit.

sections.label: the Steward
sections.text: You keep a private tally of what things cost and sleep better with something put aside.

sections.label: the Artisan
sections.text: You want comfort more than you show, good food and an evening with nothing planned.
You save what sits inside for the few people who know you best.

sections.label: The maker’s economy · 食伤生财
sections.text: What you make sells without much pushing, and the best pay comes from projects you would have done for nothing.
You move from one chapter of your life to the next without a sharp break, because no clash, punishment or harm sits between your gates.

sections.label: Four seats rule Family in your chart. Two sit in your Early Chapter and two in your Late Chapter.
sections.text: Your family trusts your word completely.

You serve your family by keeping its word, the promise honoured and the duty done on time. Because a role is how you know your place, you take the formal jobs in the family that others avoid. You hold that word more carefully than your own feelings, and the family builds on it.

sections.label: The Steward at the Year Gate · Early Chapter · birth to 15 · in plain view · lived
sections.text: Someone in your first home kept the household running on plans and a careful budget, and you watched closely. By your teens you were the child trusted with the money, the keys or the younger ones.

sections.label: The General inside the Year Gate · Early Chapter · birth to 15 · lived
sections.text: Through your first years at home you carried a weight few people saw, hard stretches and heavy demands and worries beyond your age. By your teens you were the one your family turned to in a hard week, holding firm without being asked.

sections.label: The Artisan at the Hour Gate · Late Chapter · 48 on · in plain view · now
sections.text: You have become the relative who hosts since your late forties, the one whose table the people after you head for first. You see your own habits of ease in how they now treat their guests, down to the second helping.

sections.label: The Magistrate inside the Hour Gate · Late Chapter · 48 on · now
sections.text: Since your late forties the people after you have taken your word as settled, and they have built their plans on the promises you made them. You have kept every one of them, which has given you a standing in the family that no title could.

sections.label: A Twin decade · 1994 to 2003
sections.text: Standing level with your relatives made you an equal at home, with a voice that counted as much as anyone's. You stood on your own feet, and nobody in the family spoke over you.

sections.label: A Sage decade · 2004 to 2013
sections.text: Care and support surrounded you, from family who put your needs first and helped without being asked. Feeling protected, you found the nerve to take on more than before.

sections.label: A Magistrate decade · 2024 to 2033 · now
sections.text: Obligations at home pile up, with duties to the people who rely on you and a family name to uphold. You meet them faithfully while guarding a part of your life that belongs to you alone.

sections.label: A Steward decade · 2044 to 2053
sections.text: Keeping the household in order weighs on you, and you carry more of the load than anyone else. You lean on the routines you built until the family sees the weight and takes some of it.

sections.label: 2026 · a Twin year
sections.text: With siblings and cousins weighing in, you settle family matters this year between equals of your own age.

sections.label: 2028 · an Artisan year
sections.text: This year you cook, host and make the place feel lived in, with home gathering around food and easy company.

sections.label: 2030 · a Horizon year
sections.text: Your family life widens this year to relatives far away or newly met, drawing your time and money to people beyond your own door.

sections.label: 2031 · a Steward year
sections.text: You keep the household accounts this year and see to family property, holding the home in careful order.

sections.label: 2033 · a Magistrate year
sections.text: You carry family duties in full view of your relatives this year, from the paperwork and signatures to speaking for the household.

sections.label: Three seats rule Career in your chart. Two sit in your Rising Chapter and one in your Late Chapter.
sections.text: You do your best work under real pressure.

You pick the job with the highest stakes and the tightest deadlines, and you are at your sharpest when it is going badly for everyone else. Because pressure is how you prove yourself to yourself, calm work leaves you flat and restless. What you build fastest is respect, and what you lose first is rest.

sections.label: The Virtuoso at the Month Gate · Rising Chapter · 16 to 34 · in plain view · lived
sections.text: From sixteen to your mid-thirties bosses either backed you fully or tried to slow you down, and few stayed neutral about you. You did your best work for the ones who believed in you and outstayed most of the ones who did not.

sections.label: The General inside the Month Gate · Rising Chapter · 16 to 34 · lived
sections.text: From your late teens to your mid-thirties you asked for the hard assignment, the failing project or the client nobody else could handle. You came out of each crisis more trusted, until the hardest work reached you first.

sections.label: The Artisan at the Hour Gate · Late Chapter · 48 on · in plain view · now
sections.text: Since your late forties your work has turned toward making, hosting and finishing the projects you had put off for years. You have made some of your best things in this stretch, better received than anything from your busier decades.

sections.label: A Rival decade · 1984 to 1993
sections.text: Work was a contest, and you did best when someone else wanted the same result. You were sharpest racing a rival, and that drive carried you further than skill alone.

sections.label: An Alchemist decade · 2014 to 2023
sections.text: Unusual work suited you, the kind that needs odd knowledge and long hours alone. You became good at something few others understood, earning respect before it earned you anything else.

sections.label: A Magistrate decade · 2024 to 2033 · now
sections.text: Hierarchy presses on your work, and each new duty adds to rules that are already strict. You keep your good name and hold on through the part of the work you shape yourself.

sections.label: A General decade · 2034 to 2043
sections.text: Demands pile up in your work faster than you can meet them, and a calm week feels like falling behind. You hold your ground by choosing which fights matter and letting the rest go.

sections.label: A Steward decade · 2044 to 2053
sections.text: Routine tightens around your work, and caution keeps you from moves that would pay more. You find a better fit once someone else sees what your reliability is worth.

sections.label: 2027 · a Rival year
sections.text: You keep your share this year by naming it before anyone else does, as a colleague or partner reaches for the same credit.

sections.label: 2028 · an Artisan year
sections.text: You get paid more readily this year for what you enjoy making, because your work loosens and pleases people.

sections.label: 2029 · a Virtuoso year
sections.text: Sure of your skill and short with the rules, you say out loud this year what colleagues only grumble about.

sections.label: 2031 · a Steward year
sections.text: Your pay tracks your effort this year, earned through the hours you put in and the details you get right.

sections.label: 2032 · a General year
sections.text: You hold up better than anyone expects this year, when a demanding task or a rival with standing tests your work.

sections.label: 2033 · a Magistrate year
sections.text: Your work gains a title, a rule book or a formal promise this year, leaving you with more trust at the end of it than at the start.

sections.label: Two seats rule Wealth in your chart. One sits in your Early Chapter and one in your Home Chapter.
sections.text: Your money at home is shared, and contested.

You treat money in a relationship as a shared pot, and you give freely when a partner wants something. Because sharing and competing feel like one thing to you, you match every gift and every bill, and the arguments arrive later. You are calmest about money when your share and theirs are kept apart, a split you seldom manage.

sections.label: The Steward at the Year Gate · Early Chapter · birth to 15 · in plain view · lived
sections.text: Money at home was counted and spent with care, and you learned what things cost before most children do. By your teens you were already saving what your friends spent.

sections.label: The Rival inside the Day Gate · Home Chapter · 35 to 47 · lived
sections.text: In your late thirties and forties each home you shared ran a quiet contest over money, over who earned more and who spent it faster. Your money swung between generous seasons and tight ones, because you won those contests by giving more than your share.

sections.label: Late Chapter · 48 to now · no Wealth seat.
sections.text: From your late forties, you measure money by what it lets you give the people after you, with each decade setting how much comes in.

sections.label: A Rival decade · 1984 to 1993
sections.text: Contest sharpened the way you handled money, and you went after the same prizes others wanted. With a rival close by, you learned exactly what your effort was worth.

sections.label: A Steward decade · 2044 to 2053
sections.text: Caution about money tightens, and spending on yourself feels wrong even when you can afford it. Each time you check, you find more put by than you thought and relax a little.

sections.label: 2027 · a Rival year
sections.text: You decide how much of your own goes in this year, as shared purchases and a friend's request for help pull at your money.

sections.label: 2030 · a Horizon year
sections.text: Through a second job or an unexpected offer, you take in money by side doors this year and spread it across more ventures than usual.

sections.label: 2031 · a Steward year
sections.text: Your attention turns to bills, savings and the slow work of keeping accounts this year, until you know where each part of your money goes.

sections.label: Two seats rule Health in your chart. One sits in your Early Chapter and one in your Rising Chapter.
sections.text: Your body carries the cost of your pace.

You run on adrenaline through long weeks and notice the tiredness only when the pressure lifts. Because effort is where you feel most like yourself, you push through poor sleep as if it were part of the job. Your energy runs deep, though you spend it faster than you replace it.

sections.label: The General inside the Year Gate · Early Chapter · birth to 15 · lived
sections.text: In your first years you were hardy, slow to complain and the last to quit a tough game. Your nerve carried you through hard weeks most children never faced, long before you were fifteen.

sections.label: The General inside the Month Gate · Rising Chapter · 16 to 34 · lived
sections.text: In your twenties and early thirties your body kept pace with demands that stopped most people around you. Your hardest seasons ended with you worn out for weeks, and each one taught you to stop a little sooner.

sections.label: Late Chapter · 48 to now · no Health seat.
sections.text: From your late forties, you take your energy from the decade you are in, and the people after you give your days their shape.

sections.label: A Sage decade · 2004 to 2013
sections.text: Good care kept you well, with early nights, a steady routine and someone who noticed when you were tired. You recovered quickly from strain and felt safe in your body.

sections.label: A General decade · 2034 to 2043
sections.text: Pressure costs you sleep and energy, and short nights add up faster than you notice. Once rest has a fixed place in your week, you recover fast whenever the pressure lifts.

sections.label: 2028 · an Artisan year
sections.text: Your body follows the pace you set this year, with meals, sleep and easy pleasures filling more of your days.

sections.label: 2032 · a General year
sections.text: Pressure settles into your body this year as tension you carry without noticing, and you feel it first in your sleep.

sections.label: Two seats rule Growth in your chart. One sits in your Early Chapter and one in your Late Chapter.
sections.text: You grow later by refining what you value.

You grow by doing familiar things better, holding the same values to a higher standard. Because consistency matters to you, you would rather do a thing properly than try something new, and the change in you shows up as patience. You redo a job nobody else noticed was wrong, for no reason but the standard you hold yourself to.

sections.label: The General inside the Year Gate · Early Chapter · birth to 15 · lived
sections.text: Each hard year of your childhood left you more capable than the one before, at school or at home or in a sport. You came to trust difficulty more than ease, and by your teens you went looking for it.

sections.label: The Magistrate inside the Hour Gate · Late Chapter · 48 on · now
sections.text: Since your late forties your growth has come through commitments you kept, a practice deepened or a standard raised year by year. Your standing has grown with it, and people have started bringing you the work that has to be done right.

sections.label: A Twin decade · 1994 to 2003
sections.text: Your progress came from peers who matched you, people you learned beside rather than beneath. By setting your own standard and meeting it, you built a confidence that held.

sections.label: An Alchemist decade · 2014 to 2023
sections.text: Unconventional paths taught you most, a strange course, a self-taught skill or an expert nobody else had heard of. You developed in your own direction, and the difference became your strength.

sections.label: A General decade · 2034 to 2043
sections.text: Setbacks arrive without warning, and you are pushed before you feel ready. You get through on the discipline you already have, coming out tougher in ways that show later.

sections.label: 2026 · a Twin year
sections.text: This year you see your own shape by working alongside equals, leaning less on anyone's approval and more on your own judgement.

sections.label: 2032 · a General year
sections.text: You grow fastest this year where something forces you to, a deadline or a rival or a role with real stakes.

sections.label: One seat rules Love in your chart. It sits in your Home Chapter.
sections.text: Your love runs on sharing, and on keeping count.

You love by sharing, the money and the plans and the friends, and you notice who gets the bigger part. Because a partner is also the person you measure yourself against, small questions of turn and share become contests. You give generously in love and keep a quiet tally of what comes back.

sections.label: The Rival inside the Day Gate · Home Chapter · 35 to 47 · lived
sections.text: In your late thirties and forties every relationship pooled what you both had and turned into a race over who put in more. Your eye for an uneven split sharpened with each of them, along with a soft spot for partners who gave as good as they got.
Love has no decade of its own. The pattern your Day Gate set is the one your love life keeps.

sections.label: One seat rules Social in your chart. It sits in your Rising Chapter.
sections.text: Friends and colleagues either love you or resist you.

You say the sharp thing in company, the joke that lands too close or the question nobody wanted asked. Because being remembered matters more to you than being liked, you accept that a few people cool on you after a dinner. You are closest to the people who came for that edge and defend it when you are absent.

sections.label: The Virtuoso at the Month Gate · Rising Chapter · 16 to 34 · in plain view · lived
sections.text: Through your Rising Chapter your friendships were sorted by what you said in public, in class and at work. You ended up trusting the people who argued back far more than anyone who simply agreed.

sections.label: A Rival decade · 1984 to 1993
sections.text: Lively company filled your life, friends who competed with you and pushed you on. Among rivals you were at your best, and won their respect fair and square.

sections.label: A Twin decade · 1994 to 2003
sections.text: Your friendships ran between equals, people who matched your pace and asked nothing extra. Level with every friend, you never had to shrink to be liked.

sections.label: A Magistrate decade · 2024 to 2033 · now
sections.text: Duty presses on your friendships, and social life feels more like obligation than pleasure. Your good name holds, and each promise kept steadies you a little more.

sections.label: 2026 · a Twin year
sections.text: Among friends this year, you spend more time with peers who do what you do than with anyone who looks up to you.

sections.label: 2027 · a Rival year
sections.text: This year you compete with friends for the same invitations and attention, sharing your circle more widely than you planned.

sections.label: 2029 · a Virtuoso year
sections.text: Your conversations with friends grow sharper and wittier this year, until you are the one your circle quotes the next day.

sections.label: 2030 · a Horizon year
sections.text: You move easily this year between groups that never meet each other, carried there by chance meetings and introductions.

sections.label: 2033 · a Magistrate year
sections.text: You take on roles among friends this year, a committee seat or a host's duty, and become known for showing up when you said you would.

sections.label: No seat rules Mind in your chart, and your decades set its course.
sections.text: Your thinking changes character with each decade.
Your thinking takes its colour from each decade, studious in one and restless or practical in another. You notice the change in what you read before you notice it in yourself.

sections.label: A Sage decade · 2004 to 2013
sections.text: Steady study suited you, and people who knew more than you gave your learning firm ground. You absorbed knowledge patiently, laying down much of what you know best.

sections.label: An Alchemist decade · 2014 to 2023
sections.text: Strange subjects drew you in, and you learned through instinct and odd sources more than set courses. Your thinking grew original, built on hunches that later proved right.

sections.label: 2029 · a Virtuoso year
sections.text: Your thinking sharpens against the ideas you are handed this year, finding flaws in what others accept faster than you can keep quiet about them.

sections.label: A General structure · 七杀格
sections.text: Your chart answers to pressure, the hard test and the person who pushes back. You rise when the risk is real and the deadline is close. In the thick of a fight, you are at your steadiest.
Nothing hidden in your strongest seat shows on your stems. The General who holds it is the organising force of your life, and you answer to it first.

sections.label: Formed.
sections.text: Something in your chart turns the pressure up, and your chart already carries what tempers it. You still meet hard tests, but each one arrives with its answer close by.
Water and Earth carry three quarters of your chart, and you live mostly through what you answer to and what you make.

sections.label: no Twin · your Twin decade 1994 to 2003 is lived
sections.text: Going it alone is never your first move. With a team or a close friend beside you, you find your footing faster and hold it longer.

sections.label: no Horizon · no decade of yours brings it
sections.text: Offers you did not chase seldom find you, and side doors stay shut until you knock. You earn by the front route, one job at a time, trusting what you worked for over a windfall.

sections.label: no Sage · your Sage decade 2004 to 2013 is lived
sections.text: Without a Sage you learned early to reassure yourself and to praise your own effort. You trust help more when you did not have to ask for it.

sections.label: 十月丙
sections.text: Early winter takes the sun out of season, with short days and cold water rising under you. The month wants Wood to keep your fire fed, Earth to hold back the water, and Metal to trim the Wood when it grows thick. You stay bright through the dark months by drawing on each of these as the weather changes.

sections.label: first need · 甲, the Alchemist · hidden deep
sections.text: Far beneath the surface, you hold the Alchemist as a thin thread, a trickle of its element feeding you where the season gives nothing.

sections.label: second need · 戊, the Artisan · on show
sections.text: With the Artisan on show, you send your strength out through its element, an outlet that a season short of it never opens for you.

sections.label: the Steward
sections.text: You come across as a careful provider, the one who pays on time and keeps count.

sections.label: the Virtuoso
sections.text: You strike people as quick and outspoken, the one who says what the rest of the meeting was thinking.

sections.label: the Artisan
sections.text: You seem easygoing and warm, the friend who cooks for everyone and makes hard work look light.

sections.label: the General
sections.text: You want a harder test than anyone sets you and push yourself to meet it where nobody sees.

sections.label: the Rival
sections.text: You keep score with the people closest to you, and you want to win more than you let on.

sections.label: the Magistrate
sections.text: You hold yourself to rules nobody wrote down and want a clear title that is yours alone.
You save what sits inside for the few people who know you best.

sections.label: Year and Month share 亥 · 自刑
sections.text: You play the role you had in your family again at work, the peacemaker or the one who carries everything, and change it once you see it twice.

sections.label: Hour clashes with Day · 子午冲
sections.text: The people after you pull against the life you share with a partner, but you keep both by moving house or reworking your days.
